eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: North Dakota; at 4:03 AM on AUG 15, 2022 Effective until 5:03 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
A Silver Alert is being issued by NDHP and ND BCI at the request of B I A Turtle Mountain.  Cecil "Sonny" Jeanotte of Belcourt, North Dakota, is a 77 year old American Indian male. 
He is five feet seven inches tall, weighs 170 pounds and has white hair and brown eyes.  

His last known whereabouts were on August 15, 2022, at B I A Road 12 in Belcourt, North Dakota. He is believed to be driving a maroon 2017 Chevy Silverado Duramax crew cab truck, Turtle Mountain plate 3 1 9 4 6.

Mr. Jeanotte was wearing a grey pull over sweatshirt and blue Levi jeans.

If you have any information regarding this incident, please contact B I A at 701-477-6134.

The above Silver Alert information is available to the public by calling 5 1 1 and at www.ndresponse.gov/alert.
